queries: Yes Energy June 2026 Abilene 450 MW Oracle

sources_considered.why: Accessible Motley Fool transcript of the call. Its customer-readiness passage is usable, but an apparent GPU-number transcription error limits reliance on other passages.
Primary earnings release repeats delivery claims but does not independently establish commissioning or resolve the capacity definitions.
Independent load-monitoring analysis, but the relevant measurements concern June rather than the September statement.
The live page includes September developments despite a July update label. Availability of that revision before the cutoff could not be established; its delivery interpretation also relies on Oracle.

evidence_items.publisher: The Motley Fool, syndicated by Webull
evidence_items.locator: Clayton Magouyrk prepared remarks, immediately following Abilene building deliveries
evidence_items.explanation: Oracle explicitly describes customer acceptance and workload readiness, contrary to the narrower suggestion that its statement leaves delivery entirely undefined. This establishes what Oracle said, not whether the physical delivery assertion was accurate.

evidence_items.locator: Live Power analysis of Stargate Abilene
evidence_items.explanation: The analysis reports June load growth, including approximately 407 MW elsewhere in the passage. Earlier measured consumption cannot by itself disprove a later statement about delivered IT capacity.

unresolved_gaps: No independent customer-acceptance or commissioning records matching Oracle's delivery totals were found.
The complete reconciliation between facility power, IT capacity and the prior-year comparison remains unavailable.
The independent load measurements precede the relevant delivery statement.
